const href=link?(link.getAttribute('href')||''):(dataId?('/m/'+dataId):''); if(!href) return; const u=new URL(href,base); const match=u.pathname.match(/\/m\/([^/?#]+)/); const id=(dataId||(match?match[1]:'')); seenId[id]=true; if(titleKey) seenTitle[titleKey]=true; if(!u.searchParams.get('l')) u.searchParams.set('l',lang); const img=card.querySelector('img.card-img-top,img.site-manga__cover-image,img[src*="/images/manga-thumbnails/"],img[data-src*="/images/manga-thumbnails/"]'); const coverRaw=img?(img.getAttribute('src')||img.getAttribute('data-src')||''):''; const cover=coverRaw?new URL(coverRaw,base).href:new URL('/images/manga-thumbnails/'+id+'.jpg',base).href; const author=txt(card.querySelector('h4.text-muted a,h4.text-muted,.card-subtitle,.text-muted')); const desc=txt(card.querySelector('.site-card__brief')); const latest=txt(card.querySelector('.list-group-item a[href*="/p/"],a.site-manga-thumbnail__link[href*="/p/"]')); mangas.push({id:'/m/'+id,title:title,url:u.href,cover:cover,author:author,description:desc,latestChapter:latest}); }); return JSON.stringify(mangas); })();

actions.code: (() => { const base='{{baseUrl}}'; const raw=String('{{mangaId}}'||'').trim(); const clean=(value)=>String(value||'').replace(/^\/+/, '').split(/[?#]/)[0]; const withLang=(u)=>{ if(!u.searchParams.get('l')) u.searchParams.set('l','zh'); return u.href; }; try { if(/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)){ return withLang(new URL(raw)); } if(raw.startsWith('/m/')){ return withLang(new URL(raw,base)); } const match=raw.match(/\/?m\/([^/?#]+)/); const id=match?match[1]:clean(raw); return withLang(new URL('/m/'+id,base)); } catch(_e) { return base+'/m/'+clean(raw)+'?l=zh'; } })();

(() => { const base='{{baseUrl}}'; const txt=(el)=>el?(el.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim():''; const root=document.querySelector('.site-card[data-manga-id]')||document; const current=new URL(location.href); const pathMatch=current.pathname.match(/\/m\/([^/?#]+)/); const mid=(root.getAttribute?root.getAttribute('data-manga-id')||'':'')||(pathMatch?pathMatch[1]:''); const title=txt(root.querySelector('.site-card__manga-title,h3')); const img=root.querySelector('img.site-manga__cover-image,img.card-img-top,img[src*="/images/manga-thumbnails/"],img[data-src*="/images/manga-thumbnails/"]'); const coverRaw=img?(img.getAttribute('src')||img.getAttribute('data-src')||''):''; const cover=coverRaw?new URL(coverRaw,base).href:(mid?new URL('/images/manga-thumbnails/'+mid+'.jpg',base).href:''); const author=txt(root.querySelector('h4.text-muted a,h4.text-muted,.card-subtitle')); const description=txt(root.querySelector('.site-card__brief')); const meta=txt(root.querySelector('small.text-muted')); const sm=meta.match(/連載狀態：([^最]+)/); const u=mid?new URL('/m/'+mid,base):current; if(!u.searchParams.get('l')) u.searchParams.set('l','zh'); return JSON.stringify({id:mid?'/m/'+mid:'{{mangaId}}',title:title,cover:cover,author:author,description:description,status:sm?sm[1].trim():'',url:u.href}); })();

(() => { const base='{{baseUrl}}'; const raw=String('{{mangaId}}'||'').trim(); const clean=(value)=>String(value||'').replace(/^\/+/, '').split(/[?#]/)[0]; const withLang=(u)=>{ if(!u.searchParams.get('l')) u.searchParams.set('l','zh'); return u.href; }; try { if(/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)){ return withLang(new URL(raw)); } if(raw.startsWith('/m/')){ return withLang(new URL(raw,base)); } const match=raw.match(/\/?m\/([^/?#]+)/); const id=match?match[1]:clean(raw); return withLang(new URL('/m/'+id,base)); } catch(_e) { return base+'/m/'+clean(raw)+'?l=zh'; } })();

(() => { const base='{{baseUrl}}'; const txt=(el)=>el?(el.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim():''; const chapters=[]; const seen={}; document.querySelectorAll('a.site-manga-thumbnail__link[href*="/p/"],.list-group-item a[href*="/p/"],a[href*="/p/"]').forEach((a)=>{ const u=new URL(a.getAttribute('href')||'',base); const match=u.pathname.match(/\/p\/([^/?#]+)/); const cid=match?match[1]:''; if(!cid||seen[cid]) return; seen[cid]=true; if(!u.searchParams.get('l')) u.searchParams.set('l','zh'); const img=a.querySelector('img'); const coverRaw=img?(img.getAttribute('data-src')||img.getAttribute('src')||''):''; const cover=coverRaw?new URL(coverRaw,base).href:new URL('/images/page-thumbnails/'+cid+'.jpg',base).href; const title=txt(a.querySelector('.text-center'))||(img?(img.getAttribute('alt')||''):'')||txt(a)||cid; chapters.push({id:'/p/'+cid,title:title,url:u.href,cover:cover}); }); return JSON.stringify(chapters); })();

(() => { const base='{{baseUrl}}'; const raw=String('{{chapterId}}'||'').trim(); const clean=(value)=>String(value||'').replace(/^\/+/, '').split(/[?#]/)[0]; const withLang=(u)=>{ if(!u.searchParams.get('l')) u.searchParams.set('l','zh'); return u.href; }; try { if(/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)){ return withLang(new URL(raw)); } if(raw.startsWith('/p/')){ return withLang(new URL(raw,base)); } const match=raw.match(/\/?p\/([^/?#]+)/); const id=match?match[1]:clean(raw); return withLang(new URL('/p/'+id,base)); } catch(_e) { return base+'/p/'+clean(raw)+'?l=zh'; } })();

(() => { const base='{{baseUrl}}'; const pages=[]; const seen={}; const push=(url,id)=>{ if(!url) return; const abs=new URL(url,base).href; if(seen[abs]) return; seen[abs]=true; pages.push({index:pages.length,page:pages.length,url:abs,imageUrl:abs,id:id||''}); }; document.querySelectorAll('img.site-reader__image[data-page-image-url],img[data-page-image-url]').forEach((img)=>push(img.getAttribute('data-page-image-url')||'',img.getAttribute('data-page-id')||'')); if(pages.length===0){ document.querySelectorAll('a.site-reader__one-per-page-image-link img[src*="/images/pages/"],img.site-reader__image[src*="/images/pages/"],img[src*="/images/pages/"]').forEach((img)=>push(img.getAttribute('src')||'',img.getAttribute('data-page-id')||'')); } if(pages.length===0) throw new Error('Doge Manga page list extraction returned empty'); return JSON.stringify(pages); })();
